_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — contains NO real identities. Copy to a gitignored file (e.g. rbac-bootstrap-manifest.local.json), fill in real values obtained from the operator, and pass it via --manifest. Do NOT commit a filled-in manifest in this slice.

_howToFill.ownerUserId: The stable users.id UUID of the human-approved initial OWNER. Alternatively omit this and set ownerEmail; the tool resolves it read-only to exactly one ACTIVE internal admin and prints the UUID for you to confirm with --confirm-owner-id.
_howToFill.ownerEmail: Optional legibility input for dry-run resolution. The real write is always keyed by the resolved users.id UUID, never by email.
_howToFill.adminUserIds: Zero or more stable users.id UUIDs, each an OTHER current ACTIVE internal admin who must keep users.ts access. Each becomes ADMIN. Never OWNER.
_howToFill.adminEmails: Optional legibility input, resolved the same way as ownerEmail.
_howToFill.expectedWorkspaceOrgId: Optional. The organizations.id UUID of the single internal workspace (organizations.is_internal = true). If set, the tool asserts the resolved workspace matches it.
_howToFill.expectedDbName: REQUIRED. The current_database() name the operator expects on the target (never guessed by the tool). For a real production run this is the production main DB name.
